note: The rule engine's outward shape (spec section 10.2 and 10.3): the event kinds a trigger may name, the closed action set (a kind outside it is RULE_INVALID at load, and adding one here is the visible diff section 10.2 asks for), the two alert destination kinds, the filter and rule keys, the defaults, the per-destination rate cap, the origin marker's prefix and grammar, the reasons an event is dropped before any rule runs, and the kinds of mutation no rule may ever perform. A new event kind or filter key is additive; the action set is closed by decision, not by accident.

runner.note: The runner's outward shape (spec sections 10.5, 10.6 and 17): the version key runner_state carries and a runner refuses to read newer, the two guarantees every schedule listing prints one of and the runner-held label verbatim, the backward wall jump that re-plans, how far past its wall time a fire is late, how many log lines watch status tails, the interval spelling of --every, the runner_state key prefixes, and the lock and log file names.
